notes.title: Sword Reverie 1.0 Update
notes.content:
Now is a great time to jump back into Sword Reverie 

🔥 Unique skills and strategy: Discover 16 unique player skills and 12 challenging enemy skills. Optimized skills and player skill cooldowns to allow more combos and strategic choices. 

⚡ Optimized early levels so you can get to the fun faster!

🌸Japanese VO and subtitles in English, Japanese, and Chinese (simplified/Traditional). Play in the language of your choice and get the full anime experience. 

🐞 Game optimization: We’ve greatly improved the game's performance, added many new small features, and fixed a ton of bugs including but not limited
[list]
[*] Added comfort settings
[*] Better indication when hitting enemy armor. 
[*] Better skill swap UI
[*] Issues with using teleport after level 6
[*] Correctly unlocking a weapon after completing level 12. 
[/list]

As always, thank you for checking out our game again and we hope to bring you more exciting updates soon!

notes.title: Black Friday Update

notes.title: Major update to player and enemy skills
notes.content:
We’ve been working hard behind the scenes since our last update, and we’re thrilled to announce major new updates after having heard your feedback!

🔥  Diversified gameplay: Discover 16 unique new player skills - we have doubled our previous skill set! Each skill is designed to enhance your strategies and challenge you against even the toughest enemies. Get ready to double the fun and tactics in every battle!

🌟  Fresh enemy combat: More intense combat experience than ever! We’ve boosted the difference between enemy elements by introducing 9 new enemy skills, each unique to the enemy class and element. 

🎨  Visual upgrades: We have upgraded our character shaders and enemy death VFX to bring you strong thrills with each victory.

🐞 Game optimization: We’ve addressed various performance issues and bugs to ensure better stability.


We hope you’ll enjoy this round of updates! As always, there’s more to look out for, we thank you for your continued support, stay tuned for more from the Sword Reverie Team!

notes.title: Sword Reverie Updates Starting again
notes.content:
[b]Exciting updates from the Sword Reverie Team[/b]

Hello!
First off, we owe you an apology. It’s been a while since our last update - too long, really. For the last year and a half, we faced some tough challenges. Financially, things didn’t pan out as we’d hoped, which slowed us down more than we anticipated. But here’s the thing: we believe wholeheartedly in Sword Reverie, and we haven’t stopped working towards making it the experience we all dreamed it could be.

Today, we’re thrilled to share that not only are we back in full swing, but we’ve also welcomed some new talents to our team. Say hello to Hans Fritz, Luciana Cheung, and Seyren! Each brings a wealth of creativity and expertise, and they’re as excited as we are about the game’s future. 
Now, we’ve listened to your feedback, and we have some exciting updates to share! 🎮⚔️

🤺 Transition to OpenXR: We’ve made some big changes under the hood. We moved to OpenXR so it's easier for players to launch the game on both SteamVR and Oculus headsets. We also upgraded to Unity 2022 and URP for better performance. 

💥 Updated Gameplay: You asked, we listened. You’ll now be able to see enemy health bar + damage numbers to better keep track of your impact in battles. We’ve also supercharged player speed!

✨ UI Improvements: We've tweaked the player health and mana bars, as well as the notifications for a more intuitive and immersive experience.

🐞 Performance improvements and bug fixes: We have addressed various performance issues and bugs to ensure better stability.

There’s more on the horizon, including new player and enemy skills. Regular updates are back on schedule, and we can’t wait to share our progress with you.

Thank you for your ongoing support. Stay tuned for more from Sword Reverie!

notes.title: Early Access Update 1 Now Available
notes.content:
[b]0.8.8 Early Access Update 1[/b]

The first update for Sword Reverie Early Access is here! 

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Magnus AI to attack enemies in certain cases (we will continue improving Magnus AI in the next update).
[*] Players now receive exp and items when killed.
[*] Added sitting mode and height calibration options (decide how tall or short you want to be).
[*] Added setting for snap / smooth turn speed.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes and balance changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced drag on player swords (allows the sword to more closely track player hand movement)
[*] Reduce the slow time effect duration after hitting an enemy.
[*] Increase Elemental and Humanoid enemy movement speed and attack speed.
[*] Fixed issue where certain Steam achievements aren’t being correctly set.
[*] Fixed issue when Humanoid enemy swinging down still damages player after the attack finished.
[*] Fixed issue where the player can stun-lock enemies on the ground. Enemies get up more quickly after being knocked to the ground and can not be knocked down again for a certain duration after getting up. 
[*] Player hands are better posed around Swords in a grip pose. 
[*] Improved player forearm IK to reduce player arm twisting. 
[*] Fixed issue where certain sound effects would play repeatedly when switching between guild hall and levels. 
[/list]

We are working on many more improvements based on your feedback and will continue to have updates every 1~2 months.

[b]Select items from Roadmap for next 1~3 months:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improve Magnus AI to fight enemies on more levels.
[*] Improve Ranged Enemy AI so they run away at a slower speed than when running towards you so players can catch up to them and kill them when they are running away. i
[*] Add volume settings.
[*] Change health and mana potions so players can choose when to use them (from the pause menu) instead of consuming them as soon as the player receives them.
[*] Add checkpoints to certain longer levels so players do not need to restart the whole level when they die.
[*] Add potion crafting.
[*] Add vignette comfort option.
[*] Add additional movement options (run, dash, jump).
[*] Add Japanese VO.
[*] Add Chinese and Japanese UI.
[*] Add subtitles (in English, Chinese, and Japanese).
[/list]

notes.title: 0.8.5 Early Access Week 1 Patch
notes.content:
Bug fixes and balance changes:
[list]
[*] Reduced memory usage by 40%+ and reduced memory-related crashes 
[*] Improve performance on 16GB RAM machines
[*] Reduce crashing on machines with <8GB page files
[*] Baked vegetation to reduce memory usage
[*] Optimized textures
[*] Delay loading of voice-over dialogue
[*] Added logs to end of level win menu to help debug issues with players not being able to move controllers after completing a level. New logs will help us resolve the issue if players continue to experience it in the future
[*] Fixed bug causing mana regen only once per two hits instead of once per hit. 
[*] Fixed bug where Stella and Magnus VO were not properly spatialized. 
[/list]

notes.title: We are listening to your feedback
notes.content:
A big thank you to those of you who purchased our game and provided us feedback and bug reports. We are reading all the feedback and issues you have. 

We are working hard to fix all crashes and soft lock issues and will address issues with the design that players did not like. We will do our best to make the game fun for you.

If you have experienced a crash (e.g. game crashes on the calibration menu) or a soft lock (e.g. can’t move controllers on the win menu), please help us debug by sending us the logs and crash report through email (hello@swordreverie.com) or on Discord (https://discord.gg/dUnGj3f).

Logs can be found in the following folder: C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\IsekaiEntertainmentLLC\SwordReverie
Error.log
Player.log
Player-prev.log

Crashes:
C:/Users/USERNAME/AppData/Local/Temp/IsekaiEntertainmentLLC/SwordReverie/Crashes

notes.title: Sword Reverie Closed Beta Starts 12/17
notes.content:
[img]https://i0.wp.com/swordreverie.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/early-acess-announcment-copy.jpg?resize=768%2C576&ssl=1[/img]

After 3 years in development, the Early Access portion of Sword Reverie is complete! We will be conducting a final round of testing starting on December 17th,  2021 to find bugs and adjust difficulty. Early Access release date will be announced soon!

We thank you for your continued interest in Sword Reverie. During the closed beta period, we will randomly select players who have signed up for our mailing list or playtests on Steam on a rolling basis to join the close beta starting December 17th, so keep an eye on your email and make sure you have wishlisted our game on Steam.

We look forward to having you join us in the world of Sword Reverie and love to hear your thoughts on the game!

FAQ:
How complete is the game?
[i]All features and content for the Early Access are complete, including 12 levels, the first boss fight, and the first chapter of the story. However, bugs and balance issues are to be expected. If you would like to avoid as many bugs and balance issues as possible, we suggest you wait until Early Access before playing. [/i]

Can I livestream or create videos about the Sword Reverie Closed Beta?
[i]There is no NDA for the beta, but please explain to your audience that this is a closed beta, and bugs and balance issues are to be expected. [/i]

Will my progress in the beta be saved?
[i]Unless a major bug is discovered, player progress will be carried over to Early Access. [/i]

Missing features and bugs?
[i]Digital deluxe features for Kickstarter backers, including Kickstarter exclusive weapon, Digital Artbook, and Soundtrack are not yet available and will be sent out during Early Access. [/i]

Chinese and Japanese Support
[i]Unfortunately, we haven’t finished our translation and Japanese voice acting. This is our top priority to finish after the Early Access launch. If you want to play Sword Reverie in Chinese or Japanese, please wait a little while longer. We thank you for your patience.
[/i]

notes.title: Game development for Early Access nearing completion. Beta coming soon!
notes.content:
Game development for Early Access nearing completion. Beta coming soon!

Our latest alpha build (0.7.5) has been completed. There have been many changes to the progression and difficulty balance, the music and sound design of the game, as well as two additional levels. 

We have recorded voiceovers with our voice actors up to level 7, but haven’t implemented them in-game yet. They will be implemented before our upcoming beta tests.

notes.title: Early Access Delay and Alpha Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Unfortunately, Spring 2021 has come and gone :( We did not finish Sword Reverie Early Access development in time for our original Early Access launch date. We are still hard at work on the game, and the new Early Acess date will be later this year. We will announce the specific date as soon as we finish development. 

In the meantime, Kickstarter backers are able to play the latest alpha version of the game. Our latest alpha build (0.7.3) has been completed. The build features a brand new ranged variant of the Elemental Spirit, our first ranged enemy type. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/308/701/5823b4d2f54909af494fc9d381f1e4cb_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1627164658&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=85d689bbe702d5ab77afb8fdb8c46632[/img]

Defeat the ranged elemental spirit from afar or block their ranged attack with your sword until you can get closer. 0.7.3 also has two additional levels. Level 6 introduces you to the ranged elemental. Level 7 allows you to investigate outposts to track down the Elemental Centaur.

Lots of the voice acting are still placeholders which we will replace soon. We also had some regressions on the sound effects in this build which we are working to resolve. Please bear with us. 

If you have played the alpha, please complete our survey to let us know your thoughts!

[url=https://forms.gle/ZKxgRe5eWjcfHwvh6]Survey[/url]

We plan on releasing another 1 or 2 alpha builds before we consider the content of the game ready for Beta. We are working hard to wrap up the development of all the content we had planned for Early Access. Your patience allows us to ensure that when we release in Early Access, Sword Reverie becomes the starting point for an exciting adventure. 

However, development doesn’t end there. We have additional enemies, abilities, weapons, bosses, and even graphics improvements planned ahead. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/034/308/825/648f2d706684722ddfc5f065da488b76_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1627166084&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=f633190013db442f84f9e8895705db93[/img]

notes.title: Kickstarter Coming 09/22/2020
notes.content:
The Sword Reverie Kickstarter will start [b]September 22nd, 2020[/b]. 

Get notified when our Kickstarer is live:[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/isekaient/sword-reverie-a-jrpg-inspired-vr-action-game] https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/isekaient/sword-reverie-a-jrpg-inspired-vr-action-game[/url]

The Kickstarter will allow you to support the development of the game and get the game at a discounted price at Early Access. This is also a unique opportunity to get guaranteed access to alpha and beta playtests. We are also offering awesome rewards, such as keychains, t-shirts, and plushies, and more! We will be sharing more details on social media soon. Quest and PSVR support will be stretch goals for the Kickstarter campaign, so don't get left out! 

We had multiple rounds of playtests in the past two months, and we feel like Kickstarter is the best way to continue development with the support of the community. A lot of the play testers were happy to try the game and wanted ways to support the development of the game, but felt that the original Early Access end of this year release target is too rushed. We want to address all the feedback we got, so we feel like moving Early Access to March 2021 will give us more time to polish the game. Doing a Kickstarter will give us the necessary resources to continue developing the game and allow interested supporters to try out the game sooner.
